name: SS Innovations International Inc. Common Stock
summary: SS Innovations International, Inc., situated in Fort Lauderdale, Florida, focuses on the development of sophisticated robotic systems for surgical use. Their offerings encompass the SSI Mantra, a specialized surgical robot, and SSI Mudra, a suite of surgical instruments designed to facilitate various operations, including robotic cardiac surgery. The company also provides SSI Maya, a dedicated platform for robotic surgical interventions, along with OMNI 3D HD, which delivers a real-time, high-definition 3D perspective of the surgical field within the operating room.
